answer: Special Ops chorus rule: discount votes that only echo each other. Attestations are tallied like cluster-matched quadratic funding: each grader's support counts as a square root, and any identities whose grading histories overlap far above the network baseline have their shared votes merged into one voice. A 1,000-key farm praising itself hears only its own echo, worth about one grader. Reward nectar flows only to answers backed by independent clusters, so the farm must win the pulse of real strangers' approval, which means doing genuinely good work.
